title: Attachments
notes: Attach files to a message: the + button, drag and drop onto the chat, or paste a screenshot.
Claude sees images and PDFs directly; other files (CSV, logs, text) are saved on your PC and Claude opens them by path.
Attached files are kept with the chat: in Home for General chats, in the project's folder for project chats (left out of git).
Reopened chats show the same thumbnails and file chips; a file you moved shows as "no longer there".
Deleting a chat forever asks whether to keep its files (moved to attachments\_kept) or delete them too; the 30-day clean-up always keeps them.
Programs and scripts are refused, and every file is served safely: pictures and PDFs open in the browser, everything else downloads.

history.title: Counted downloads
notes: The Download button now downloads from GitHub Releases, so each version's downloads are counted.
Installed Studios still update from this website, exactly as before.
The Privacy section explains what downloading through GitHub means.

history.title: Trust levels and Start with Windows
notes: New Work freely in this project level: Claude edits that project's files and runs ordinary commands without asking, while deleting, publishing and chained commands still ask.

Permission cards: any command can be allowed once at any length, rule errors say what is wrong, and a new Allow bookkeeping files button (Settings, Permissions) lets log and memory updates run without asking.
Start with Windows: a Startup switch in Settings, Updates starts Studio when you sign in (off by default).
Reopened chats show Allowed lines instead of cancelled cards.

history.title: Website and updates
notes: This website, with the installer and release notes.
Studio checks for updates and installs them in one click, going back by itself if a new version doesn't start.
Studios from before v0.17: unzip this release and run Install Claude Studio.cmd to upgrade in place.
